input.description: Whenever someone asks for a documentation-only fix — a README, a CHANGELOG entry, a design note — draft a small build workflow confined to docs and Markdown files, nothing else.

draft-workflow.name: docs-only
draft-workflow.description: documentation only: the agent may change docs/ and Markdown files, nothing else
draft-workflow.toml:
name = "docs-only"
description = "documentation only: the agent may change docs/ and Markdown files, nothing else"
steps = [
  { action = "setup" },
  { action = "docs" },
]
draft-workflow.rationale: The catalog already has a "docs" directive whose code contract is confined to docs/ and *.md (paths), which is exactly the write scope the description asks for; "setup" ahead of it is what every build workflow runs first so the directive starts check-ready. No new action needed.
